create_depth_renderer: create a DepthRenderer instance with an object mesh, camera intrinsics, and camera name for depth rendering
render_depth_map: render a depth map of an object mesh given its 4x4 pose relative to the camera
compute_vertex_visibility: compute the 2D projection locations and binary visibility of object mesh vertices using Z-buffer depth comparison

review_depth_renderer_class: review the DepthRenderer class that renders object or hand meshes into depth maps using pyrender and OSMesa
